============================================================================
OmniBuf-Py Benchmark Suite (Python 3.14.5 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (366B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
Methodology: Full decode reads all 11 fields; mutations check city and increment/grow.
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 372 ns | 2,684,698 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (@dataclass) | 375 ns | 2,668,025 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobuf-py | 948 ns | 1,055,187 | 341 | 2.54x slower |
| google.protobuf (upb) | 437 ns | 2,288,312 | 341 | 1.17x slower |
| msgspec | 632 ns | 1,581,915 | 634 | 1.70x slower |
| msgpack | 1,681 ns | 594,795 | 634 | 4.51x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 4,844 ns | 206,440 | 874 | 13.00x slower |
